Part of [`evoxc.ir`](/api/evoxc/ir/)

A source-code position.

## Attributes

- `file` · `str` — Path of the source file (as written at trace time).

- `line` · `int` — 1-based line number.

- `col` · `int` — 1-based column number.

- `code_snippet` · `str | None` — Optional single-line snippet of the source at that
  position (None when unavailable).
